title: DalalQuant: a browser-based terminal for Indian markets
description: DalalQuant is a single-page terminal for investing, trading and algorithmic trading on NSE/BSE, with US stocks, world indices, commodities, FX, bonds and crypto. It runs entirely in the browser and provides market briefings, breadth and sentiment indicators, sector rotation, a government policy tracker, screeners, backtesting and strategy tools; an optional bridge adds real-time data, news and order routing through the user's own broker account.
